items.title: British man dies in paragliding accident in Spain
items.title_zh: 英国人死于西班牙的滑翔事故
items.summary: A 63-year-old British man has died in a paragliding accident in Spain's north-eastern Catalonia region, authorities have said.
items.summary_zh: 一位63岁的英国男子在西班牙加泰罗尼亚东北部地区的滑翔事故中丧生,当局表示.

items.title: Will Putin change tactics after Ukrainian drone attacks?
items.title_zh: 乌克兰无人机攻击后普京是否会改变战术?
items.summary: Moscow has come under the largest Ukrainian attack since the start of the full-scale war, with close to 200 drones hitting targets around the Russian capital and setting columns of thick smoke billowing high into the sky.
items.summary_zh: 莫斯科受到乌克兰自全面战争开始以来最大的攻击,近200架无人机击中俄罗斯首都周围的目标,并将高空投下浓烟的柱子。

items.title: Moment Trump signs US-Iran agreement at Palace of Versailles
items.title_zh: 特朗普在凡尔赛宫签署美伊协议
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has signed an agreement to extend the ceasefire with Iran in France's Palace of Versailles, just outside Paris.
items.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在巴黎外的凡尔赛宫与伊朗签署延长停火协议.

items.title: US-Iran deal leaves core sticking points unresolved - and a $300bn question
items.title_zh: 美国-伊朗协议未解决核心问题,
items.summary: The US-Iran memorandum of understanding announced on Wednesday amounts to a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and a deal to try to reach a final agreement on almost everything else.
items.summary_zh: 美国-伊朗星期三宣布的谅解备忘录相当于重新开放霍尔木兹海峡,并达成协议,试图就几乎所有其它问题达成最后协议。

items.title: What's in the US-Iran agreement?
items.title_zh: 美伊协议是什么?
items.summary: A US-Iran agreement to extend the ceasefire between the two countries has been signed and is now in effect, a White House official has confirmed to the BBC.
items.summary_zh: 美国-伊朗关于延长两国停火的协议已经签署,现在生效,一位白宫官员已向英国广播公司确认.

items.title: 'I buried my parents one day after the other' - Ebola mourners learn how to grieve safely
items.title_zh: 埃博拉的哀悼者学会了如何安全哀悼
items.summary: Nyamurongo cemetery in Bunia, a city in north-eastern Democratic Republic of Congo that is the epicentre of the current Ebola outbreak, is much busier than usual.
items.summary_zh: 布尼亚的Nyamurongo墓地是刚果民主共和国东北部的一个城市,是目前埃博拉疫情的震中,比往常繁忙得多。

items.title: 'We had to get out of the way': The backlash over delivery robots
items.title_zh: "我们必须让开": 对送货机器人的反弹
items.summary: The first time Chicago resident John Roberts saw a delivery robot trundling down the sidewalk on his street he was impressed.
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥居民约翰·罗伯茨 第一次见到一个送货机器人 在他的街上人行道上摇晃 他印象深刻

items.title: 'They came with machetes' - deadline looms for migrants to leave South Africa
items.title_zh: 移民离开南非的最后期限即将到来。
items.summary: South Africa has become a hostile place for undocumented migrants, as a deadline set by protesters for them to leave the country approaches.
items.summary_zh: 南非已成为无证移民的敌对场所,抗议者为他们离开该国规定了最后期限。
